marker_glossary.BLOCKED: This lane is blocked by an open issue.
marker_glossary.MISSING_PAYLOAD: We expected a status file for this lane but did not find one.
marker_glossary.OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: A human decision is required before this lane can advance.
marker_glossary.PASS: This lane has passed its own gate.
marker_glossary.READY: This lane is ready (in its narrow sense; does not imply live readiness).
marker_glossary.approves_canary=false: This report does not approve enabling a canary (single-order live) run.
marker_glossary.approves_legacy_shutdown=false: Legacy bot must keep running. We are not approving its shutdown.
marker_glossary.approves_live=false: This report does not approve enabling live trading.
marker_glossary.approves_redis_trim=false: We are not approving deletion of legacy Redis keys.
marker_glossary.automation_executing: True only when a worker is actively holding a lease on a task right now.
marker_glossary.legacy_shutdown_ready: It is safe to turn off the legacy bot. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.live_gate=blocked_human_only: Live trading switch is off. Only a human operator can enable it.
marker_glossary.live_ready: V2 is safe to enable for live trading. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.live_symbols=[]: No symbol is approved for live trading. The live universe is empty.
marker_glossary.migration_complete: V2 fully replaces legacy in production. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.paper_edge_proven: Paper trading has produced a statistically significant positive after-cost edge.
marker_glossary.production_equivalence_blocked=true: V2 has not yet been proven to match legacy in production behavior.
marker_glossary.shutdown_blocked=true: Legacy shutdown is blocked because V2 is not yet a production replacement.
marker_glossary.worker_capacity_ready: Daemon workers are running but they may have zero active leases.
